regime_context: The detector shows a classic high-commodity, anti-financial regime in Canada: Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties hold the top two ranks with strong, broad (breadth 1.0) leadership and above-median durability, while the rest of the eligible universe is mixed-to-negative. The macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics with an 0.88 unscheduled-surprise share, consistent with flight-to-hard-assets price action, but the rotation radar margin (0.147) is narrow and rotation is non-directional (one_narrative false, directional false), so this is a genuine two-metal leadership structure, not a single dominant story. Gate discipline is validated here (gate_helps true), and the track record shows a modest 0.62 hit rate but a poor 0.33 directional accuracy — I will keep conviction low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed handoff from the two-metal leadership structure into Oil & Gas Producers: despite the current crowding flag, if XEG.TO's breadth (0.714) re-expands back toward 0.85+ AND its crowding_z drops below 1.0, that would indicate the crowding has worked off and breadth is re-broadening — the observable that would retire this watch is breadth decaying below 0.5 (confirming the energy leadership is breaking rather than consolidating).

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the prevailing leadership theme: rank 1, eligible (above the absolute-trend gate), breadth 1.0 meaning the whole cohort is participating, and a 0.73 durability bar (the highest in the eligible set) suggesting the trend structure is intact rather than a one-day spike. Crowding is absent (crowded false, z 0.65), so there is no size-down caution. The lean is a trend-following continuation stance grounded in the one validated leg — the trend gate — with the rank/durability used only as a focus confirmation, per the reader contract.
evidence: rank 1 with score 2.145 and eligible true (above absolute-trend gate)
theses.dissent: Gold is a reflexivity-prone, momentum-crowded trade at the macro level: if geopolitical headlines are already dominant (0.88 unscheduled share) and the theme has already run to rank 1, the marginal buyer may be exhausted. The 0.33 directional accuracy in the track record warns that even a well-supported narrative can reverse without warning, and a mean-reverting gold tape would hurt the entire precious-metals complex at once.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (Gold Miners proxy) underperforms the S&P/TSX by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 21-trading-day check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the challenger in the two-metal leadership structure: rank 2, eligible, breadth 1.0, and a durability bar (0.67) that is strong but slightly below Gold's (0.73). The narrow margin (0.147) between leader and challenger means Gold and Silver are effectively co-leading rather than one dominating. The overweight is the same trend-following logic as Gold — above the gate, full participation — expressed as a direction rather than a size. Silver's 'mean-revert' hurst tag adds a mild caution that its trend may be less persistent than Gold's 'mixed' tag.
evidence: rank 2 with score 1.998 and eligible true (above absolute-trend gate)
rotation margin 0.147 — Gold and Silver co-leading
theses.dissent: Silver is a high-beta twin of Gold: if the precious-metals theme rolls over, Silver typically falls faster and deeper. The 'mean-revert' hurst tag and the fact that both top themes share the same ETF proxy (XGD.TO) mean this is not really a diversified second call — it is a second expression of the exact same Gold thesis, doubling down on one macro bet with no offsetting diversifier.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (shared proxy for both Gold and Silver themes) underperforms the S&P/TSX by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers has the only crowding flag in the eligible set (crowded true, crowding_z 1.2), and its breadth has already decayed to 0.714 — participation is thinning. The rank (3) and score (1.22) still look healthy, but the crowding flag is a explicit size-down caution per the guardrails, and the shrinking breadth suggests the leadership is narrowing rather than broadening. An 'avoid' lean here is a de-risking stance, not a short call: the trend gate still says eligible, so the theme has not broken, but the texture argues for standing aside rather than adding.
evidence: crowded true with crowding_z 1.2 — the only crowded eligible theme
breadth 0.714 — participation already thinning vs 1.0 for the metals leaders
eligible true but durability_bar 0.63 — mid-pack, not compelling
guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade or short
theses.dissent: Energy is one of the four macro narratives currently in the headline flow, and oil can gap hard on geopolitical supply shocks — an 'avoid' could miss a sharp upside. The theme is still above the absolute-trend gate with a positive score, so the structural trend has not broken; standing aside is a judgement call that the crowding/breadth texture is a headwind, not a validated edge.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO (Oil & Gas proxy) outperforms the S&P/TSX by 5% before the check-by date while the crowding flag remains true
